_comment: Curated, AI-drafted enrichment for the PooyanPacs Learn migration. Keyed by source course folder. All text is AI-generated from DICOM-derived facts (modality/body part) and should be reviewed by an educator. No specific diagnoses are asserted. 'ai': true marks the course needs-review.

Course-10.title: Knee, Thigh & Femur MRI - Teaching Cases
Course-10.description: A musculoskeletal MRI teaching collection of the knee, thigh and femur. The cases support a systematic review of the menisci, cruciate and collateral ligaments, articular cartilage, extensor mechanism and bone marrow across standard multiplanar MR sequences.
objectives: Review normal knee, thigh and femoral MR anatomy across planes and sequences.
Apply a structured search pattern to the menisci, ligaments, cartilage and extensor mechanism.
Recognise common internal derangement, soft-tissue and marrow abnormalities of the knee and thigh.

Course-1010.title: TMJ & Maxillofacial Imaging - Panoramic, CT & MRI
Course-1010.description: A maxillofacial teaching collection of the temporomandibular joint (TMJ), skull and head combining panoramic radiography, CT and MRI. Cases emphasise correlative osseous and soft-tissue evaluation of the TMJ and facial skeleton across modalities.
objectives: Correlate panoramic, CT and MR findings of the TMJ and facial skeleton.
Evaluate the mandibular condyle, articular eminence and disc position.
Recognise degenerative and structural abnormalities of the TMJ.

Course-1011.title: Temporomandibular Joint (TMJ) - CT & MRI Cases
Course-1011.description: Focused TMJ teaching cases using CT and MRI, including degenerative joint disease material. Emphasis is on condylar morphology, joint-space assessment, and disc and soft-tissue evaluation.
objectives: Assess condylar and articular-surface morphology on CT.
Evaluate disc position and joint effusion on MRI.
Identify imaging features associated with TMJ degenerative joint disease.

Course-2011.title: Foot & Ankle MRI - Teaching Cases
Course-2011.description: Musculoskeletal MRI of the foot and ankle with correlative radiographs. The cases support a systematic review of the tendons, ligaments, osseous structures and plantar soft tissues.
objectives: Review normal foot and ankle MR anatomy.
Systematically evaluate the tendons, ligaments and bones of the foot and ankle.
Recognise common foot and ankle pathology.

Course-2012.title: Shoulder MRI - Comprehensive Teaching Collection
Course-2012.description: A large shoulder MRI teaching collection. Practise evaluation of the rotator cuff, labrum, biceps tendon, acromioclavicular joint and osseous structures across standard shoulder MR planes and sequences.
objectives: Apply a structured approach to shoulder MR interpretation.
Evaluate the rotator cuff, glenoid labrum and biceps anchor.
Recognise common shoulder pathology and impingement patterns.

Course-2013.title: Lower-Limb MRI - Knee, Ankle & Leg (Comprehensive)
Course-2013.description: A large lower-extremity MRI teaching collection covering the knee, ankle and leg with correlative radiographs. The cases support joint-by-joint systematic review of articular structures, ligaments, tendons and marrow.
objectives: Review knee, ankle and leg MR anatomy.
Apply systematic joint-by-joint search patterns to the lower limb.
Recognise common lower-limb internal derangement and soft-tissue injury.

Course-3.title: Mixed Cases - Shoulder MRI & Mammography
Course-3.description: A mixed teaching set containing shoulder MRI and mammographic (MG) breast-imaging cases. Note: this collection spans two distinct topics that were migrated together; consider splitting it into separate courses during review.
objectives: Review shoulder MR anatomy and common findings.
Review a systematic approach to mammographic interpretation.
Distinguish the imaging features and reporting approach specific to each modality.

Course-4.title: Foot Radiograph - Single Teaching Case
Course-4.description: A single digital-radiography (DX) case of the foot. Useful as a focused spotter for foot radiographic anatomy, alignment and a systematic review approach.
objectives: Review normal foot radiographic anatomy and alignment.
Describe a systematic approach to interpreting the foot radiograph.

Course-7.title: Hand, Wrist & Finger Imaging - Multimodality
Course-7.description: A multimodality teaching collection of the hand, wrist and fingers using radiography, ultrasound, CT and MRI. The cases support cross-modality correlation for osseous, articular and soft-tissue assessment.
objectives: Correlate radiographic, ultrasound, CT and MR findings of the hand and wrist.
Evaluate the carpus, joints and tendons with a systematic approach.
Recognise common hand, wrist and finger pathology.

Course-8.title: Wrist & Hand MRI - Teaching Cases
Course-8.description: Musculoskeletal MRI of the wrist and hand with correlative radiographs. Emphasis on the carpal bones, triangular fibrocartilage complex (TFCC), intrinsic ligaments and tendons.
objectives: Review wrist and hand MR anatomy.
Evaluate the TFCC, intrinsic ligaments and tendons.
Recognise common wrist and hand pathology.

Course-9.title: Ankle MRI - Teaching Cases
Course-9.description: A focused ankle MRI teaching collection. Practise systematic evaluation of the tendons (peroneal, posterior tibial and Achilles), the ligaments and the osteochondral surfaces.
objectives: Review normal ankle MR anatomy.
Systematically assess the ankle tendons and ligaments.
Recognise osteochondral and soft-tissue abnormalities of the ankle.
